title: The Latest: A New Word for What Trump Did

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: Tonight, allegations of a White House cover-up as details of a whistleblower's complaint are revealed.
sentences.zh: 今晚，随着举报人投诉细节的披露，白宫掩盖真相的指控浮出水面。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: In that call, the president asked for an investigation of Democratic presidential hopeful
sentences.zh: 在那次通话中，总统要求对民主党总统候选人

sentences.en: Joe Biden and his son Hunter.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登和他的儿子亨特进行调查。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院将推进正式的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Now the burden is on the Democrats, really, to tell Americans the story of what happened and why it's impeachable.
sentences.zh: 现在民主党人的重任，确实是向美国人讲述发生了什么以及为什么这值得弹劾。

sentences.en: This spectacle is doing great damage to our country.
sentences.zh: 这场闹剧正在对我们的国家造成巨大的损害。

sentences.en: It's nothing more than an impeachment process in search of a crime.
sentences.zh: 这不过是一个为了寻找罪名而进行的弹劾程序。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: It's November 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月14日。

sentences.en: The latest over here is the fallout from yesterday's first day of public impeachment hearings.
sentences.zh: 这里最新的消息是昨天第一天公开弹劾听证会后的余波。

sentences.en: And this morning in the
sentences.zh: 今天早上在

sentences.en: Capitol, across town from here...
sentences.zh: 国会大厦，就在城的那一边……

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi, the House Speaker, had her weekly press conference.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西举行了她的每周新闻发布会。

sentences.en: We passed a packet of bills, nine bills.
sentences.zh: 我们通过了一揽子法案，共九项法案。

sentences.en: She talked about a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了很多事情。

sentences.en: And of course...
sentences.zh: 当然……

sentences.en: On the investigation front, yesterday was a very somber, prayerful day.
sentences.zh: 在调查方面，昨天是非常沉重、充满祈祷的一天。

sentences.en: She talked about impeachment.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了弹劾。

sentences.en: Again, none of us have come to Congress to impeach a president.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我们中没有人是为了弹劾总统而来到国会的。

sentences.en: We come here to do the work of the
sentences.zh: 我们来到这里是为了完成

sentences.en: American people to make the future better.
sentences.zh: 美国人民的工作，让未来变得更好。

sentences.en: And the moment that really caught my attention was when she was talking about Bill Taylor's testimony.
sentences.zh: 真正引起我注意的时刻是她谈到比尔·泰勒的证词时。

sentences.en: Yesterday, you heard an appointment of the president speak in very unambiguous terMs.
sentences.zh: 昨天，你们听到总统的一位任命人以非常明确的措辞发言。

sentences.en: He's the top American diplomat in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他是美国驻乌克兰的最高外交官。

sentences.en: The devastating testimony corroborated evidence of bribery uncovered in the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这份毁灭性的证词证实了调查中发现的贿赂证据。

sentences.en: She says, you know, his testimony corroborates the evidence of bribery.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，他的证词证实了贿赂的证据。

sentences.en: Threatening to withhold military aid and a White House meeting in exchange for an investigation into his political rival.
sentences.zh: 以扣留军事援助和白宫会晤为要挟，换取对政治对手的调查。

sentences.en: It seems sort of no big deal.
sentences.zh: 这看起来好像没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: She's just going over what happened yesterday, going back through the testimony.
sentences.zh: 她只是在回顾昨天发生的事情，重新梳理证词。

sentences.en: But I thought, actually, there's something quite important here.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，实际上，这里面有些非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: She used the word bribery to describe what the president did and what Ambassador Taylor was corroborating.
sentences.zh: 她用了“贿赂”这个词来描述总统所做的事情以及泰勒大使所证实的内容。

sentences.en: And to me, it sounded significant and like it was not an accident that she used that word.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这听起来意义重大，而且她使用这个词似乎并非偶然。

sentences.en: This is a word that we have heard Democrats start to use this week.
sentences.zh: 这是我们本周开始听到民主党人使用的词。

sentences.en: If we find that the president of the United States abused his power, or if he sought to condition, coerce, extort, or bribe an ally...
sentences.zh: 如果我们发现美国总统滥用职权，或者他试图以条件交换、胁迫、勒索或贿赂盟友……

sentences.en: Adam Schiff, the chairman of the Intelligence Committee, used it.
sentences.zh: 情报委员会主席亚当·希夫使用了这个词。

sentences.en: His counsel, Dan Goldman, used it during the questioning, in the hearing.
sentences.zh: 他的法律顾问丹·戈德曼在听证会的质询中也使用了它。

sentences.en: Regardless of what you call it, whether it's a quid pro quo, bribery, extortion, abuse of power...
sentences.zh: 不管你怎么称呼它，无论是“交换条件”、贿赂、勒索、滥用职权……

sentences.en: Even the Republicans used it in characterizing what Democrats say happened.
sentences.zh: 甚至共和党人在描述民主党人所说的事情时也用了这个词。

sentences.en: The Democrats claim this call demonstrates extortion, bribery, and a host of other...
sentences.zh: 民主党人声称这次通话证明了勒索、贿赂以及其他一系列……

sentences.en: Let's talk about extortion.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈勒索。

sentences.en: Let's talk about bribery.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈贿赂。

sentences.en: Let's talk about cover-up.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈掩盖真相。

sentences.en: We impeach presidents for treason or bribery or other high crimes.
sentences.zh: 我们因叛国、贿赂或其他严重罪行而弹劾总统。

sentences.en: Where is the impeachable offense in that call?
sentences.zh: 那次通话中哪里有可弹劾的罪行？

sentences.en: And here's what's going on with this word bribery.
sentences.zh: 这就是关于“贿赂”这个词的情况。

sentences.en: The hard part for Democrats so far in this whole impeachment scenario has been getting the American public to understand why the president putting
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，在整个弹劾过程中，民主党人的难点在于让美国公众理解为什么总统向乌克兰施压

sentences.en: pressure on Ukraine is not just bad, it's actually impeachable.
sentences.zh: 不仅是错误的，而且实际上是可弹劾的。

sentences.en: So they've been talking about pressure, personal favors, they've been using the phrase quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在谈论压力、个人恩惠，一直在使用“交换条件”这个词。

sentences.en: But what they seem to have decided is that they need a word, they need to put a name to this that people associate with impeachment.
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎已经决定，他们需要一个词，需要给这件事起一个人们与弹劾联系在一起的名字。

sentences.en: And it's going to be a word that, should they get to the point of offering articles of impeachment, is going to be critical to that.
sentences.zh: 如果他们到了提出弹劾条款的地步，这将是一个至关重要的词。

sentences.en: And that's what's outlined in the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 这就是宪法中概述的内容。

sentences.en: It says the president, vice president, and all civil officers of the United States shall be removed from office on impeachment for and conviction of treason, bribery, or other high
sentences.zh: 宪法规定，总统、副总统和美国所有文职官员，如被弹劾并被判犯有叛国、贿赂或其他严重

sentences.en: crimes and misdemeanors.
sentences.zh: 罪行和轻罪，即应被免职。

sentences.en: And so now we see the Democrats trying to attach that word bribery to what happened because they know that language is powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们看到民主党人试图将“贿赂”这个词与所发生的事情联系起来，因为他们知道这种语言很有力量。

sentences.en: And it's interesting, in the press conference today, a reporter picked up on it and asked Pelosi about it.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在今天的新闻发布会上，一位记者注意到了这一点，并就此询问了佩洛西。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Speaker Pelosi, you talked about bribery a second ago.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西议长，您刚才提到了贿赂。

sentences.en: Yes, bribery.
sentences.zh: 是的，贿赂。

sentences.en: That's a very serious charge.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常严重的指控。

sentences.en: What makes this a case of bribery?
sentences.zh: 是什么让这成为一个贿赂案件？

sentences.en: Well, you know, we're talking Latin around here, quid pro quo, bribery, bribery.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们在这里谈论拉丁语，交换条件，贿赂，贿赂。

sentences.en: And that is in the Constitution attached to the impeachment proceedings.
sentences.zh: 这在宪法中与弹劾程序联系在一起。

sentences.en: So what was the bribe here?
sentences.zh: 那么这里的贿赂是什么？

sentences.en: The bribe is to grant or withhold military assistance in return for a public statement of a fake investigation into the elections.
sentences.zh: 贿赂就是以提供或扣留军事援助为条件，换取对选举进行虚假调查的公开声明。

sentences.en: So could we be looking at an article of impeachment?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是否可能看到弹劾条款？

sentences.en: I don't know about that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We haven't even made a decision to impeach.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至还没有做出弹劾的决定。

sentences.en: That's what the inquiry is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是调查的目的。

sentences.en: But I am saying that what the president has admitted to and says it's perfect, I say it's perfectly wrong.
sentences.zh: 但我说的是，总统承认并称之为完美的事情，我认为是完全错误的。

sentences.en: It's bribery.
sentences.zh: 这就是贿赂。

sentences.en: So I'm going to be looking for how Democrats keep pushing that word and how Republicans respond to that and actually how Americans react to that characterization.
sentences.zh: 所以我将关注民主党人如何继续推动这个词，共和党人如何回应，以及美国人实际上如何看待这种定性。

sentences.en: Is that something that resonates with the public?
sentences.zh: 这是否能引起公众的共鸣？

sentences.en: If they buy the idea that the president withholding military assistance in return for a public statement by Ukraine that it was investigating the
sentences.zh: 如果他们相信总统以扣留军事援助为条件，换取乌克兰发表关于调查

sentences.en: Bidens, whether they think that was bribery and whether they think that is enough to impeach a president.
sentences.zh: 拜登一家的公开声明，他们是否认为这是贿赂，以及他们是否认为这足以弹劾一位总统。

sentences.en: So tomorrow we've got the second day of public hearings.
sentences.zh: 明天我们将进行第二天的公开听证会。

sentences.en: We're going to hear from
sentences.zh: 我们将听到

sentences.en: Marie Yovanovitch, the former U.S.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·约万诺维奇的证词，她是前美国

sentences.en: ambassador to Ukraine, who was removed by the president earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 驻乌克兰大使，今年早些时候被总统免职。

sentences.en: And I think one way that Democrats will try to use her testimony is to use her as an
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党人试图利用她的证词的一种方式，是将她作为

sentences.en: example of the type of person, the type of public official who essentially needed to be shunted aside
sentences.zh: 一个例子，说明那种本质上需要被排挤的公职人员类型，

sentences.en: in order for this bribery scheme, in order for this improper conduct to be possible.
sentences.zh: 以便让这种贿赂计划、这种不当行为成为可能。

sentences.en: And I think they'll try to do that by pointing to the timing of her ouster.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们会通过指出她被免职的时间点来做到这一点。

sentences.en: She was removed in May and two months later, the president made this call to President Zelensky of Ukraine that started this whole saga.
sentences.zh: 她在五月被免职，两个月后，总统与乌克兰总统泽连斯基进行了这次通话，开启了整个传奇。

sentences.en: So yeah, that's the lateSt. This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就是最新的消息。本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
